title: Binary addition column identity
statement: For Boolean bits $c,u,v$, let the low result bit be their exclusive-or and let the outgoing carry be their majority bit. Their numeric values satisfy $\operatorname{val}(u)+\operatorname{val}(v)+\operatorname{val}(c)=2\operatorname{val}(\text{outgoing carry})+\operatorname{val}(\text{low result bit})$, where a true bit has value $1$ and a false bit has value $0$.
replaced: For every carry bit $c$ and addend bits $u$ and $v$, the sum of the three digit values equals twice the outgoing carry's value plus the low result bit's value.
